GitHub is hiding some INSANE animation tools. 🤯🔥

You don't need expensive software to create Hollywood-style animations, motion graphics, 2D cartoons, or cinematic VFX.

From traditional 2D animation to realistic smoke simulations, these tools are worth bookmarking. 👀

Here's what you'll discover:

🎬 OpenToonz — Create full 2D animated productions
🎨 Friction — Create vector & raster motion graphics
🕺 FreeMoCap — Capture real human movement in 3D
💥 Natron — Create professional visual effects
✏️ Synfig Studio — Animate without drawing every frame
🔥 Effekseer — Create explosions, fire & particle effects
🌐 Theatre.js — Build interactive website animations
🖌️ Pencil2D — Create hand-drawn cartoons
🎥 OpenVDB — Work with cinematic 3D volume data
⚡ SVG.js — Animate SVG graphics in your browser

The best part? Most of these tools are completely FREE.
